verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a well-formed llms.txt at docs.runpod.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200, proper header and summary). Doc pages are also served as raw .md URLs, and there are dedicated agent-facing pages for agent skills and MCP servers, so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable docs directly. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-corpus export, and no independent or hands-on report of agents actually consuming the docs.
